title: Grateful Dead Live at Building A, Cal Expo on 1969-11-21
lineage: Transfer: Panasonic SV-3700 > Cardas cable S/PDIF > Edirol UA-5 > USB > WaveLab > CD Wave > TLH > Flac

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording captures a solid 1969 second set with standout High Time, Lovelight and a teasing Me & My Uncle, despite minor track‑gap quirks.
ai_review.review: The tape offers a surprisingly clear soundboard capture for its era – Pigpen’s Fender keys cut through nicely and the overall mix is clean. Musically the second half shines, highlighted by a powerful High Time, a rocking Lovelight and an exciting Me & My Uncle tease; listeners note the first set can be skipped and complain only of a brief silence between China Cat Sunflower and I Know You Rider.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently positive comments about performance and decent soundboard quality; minor formatting issue does not detract from overall enjoyment.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear mix with Pigpen's keyboards prominent; a small two‑second silence between tracks noted, but no major dropouts or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set is the highlight – energetic and well‑performed; first set deemed skippable by at least one reviewer. Minor annoyance with a pause between China Cat Sunflower and I Know You Rider.

band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen's Fender keyboard work is especially present and praised.
